explanation: The vulnerable code in sync_course_runs_from_request verifies an HMAC authorization signature against expected signatures using the non-constant-time == operator inside an any() generator, leaking byte-by-byte comparison timing that enables remote signature forgery. The fixed code replaces == with hmac.compare_digest, materially correcting the timing side channel. This is a genuine application-level cryptographic misuse matching CWE-208 / CRYPTO-013.
finding: HMAC signature compared with non-constant-time '==' operator in sync_course_runs_from_request; use hmac.compare_digest for authentication-sensitive comparisons.
note: Code pair is complete and directly demonstrates the vulnerable comparison and its fix; the 'any()' short-circuit across multiple secrets adds minor additional timing leakage not addressed by the fix, but the primary == misuse is corrected. No license information supplied.
